base_title: Why Meta Bought a Broken AI Social Network
description:
Meta did not buy Moltbook because it was healthy. The brokenness was part of the strategic value.

This cinematic brief turns the Moltbook story into a sharper acquisition argument about internal politics, platform leverage, and the economics of the emerging agentic social graph.

It should work as a discovery object even for viewers who never read the original post.
